policies.decision: Whole-tree quarantine for every unproven completed task or Step.
Exact published aliases, check, event, parent, physical owner, source and consistent timestamps; no title/line/latest inference.
Typed truthy IDs group only identical rows; falsey/missing IDs remain independent occurrences; contradictory groups have no winner.
Quarantined canonical mappings remain in raw ordered compatibility input.
Raw chart time stays unchanged; canonical time requires proof, otherwise null; archive fallback is not proof.
Event UUID preparation in native repository is deferred to E2; E1 allocates zero.
Pinned published N1-B snapshot, verified N1-C source, synthetic exclusive coordination only; no plan consumption.
One complete ordered capture per lineage; changed/overlapping captures require later reconciliation.
Persistent import recovery fencing is deferred to E2; E1 offers no fence API.

observation.message: Statistics cannot interpret some recorded completion evidence safely.
